claims: The 2026 WNBA Draft takes place on Monday, April 13, 2026.
The 2026 WNBA Draft takes place at 7 p.m. ET.
The 2026 WNBA Draft is held at The Shed at Hudson Yards in New York City.
The 2026 WNBA Draft will be broadcast live on ESPN.
Coverage of the 2026 WNBA Draft is available on the ESPN App.
Coverage of the 2026 WNBA Draft is available on SiriusXM NBA Radio.
"WNBA Countdown" pre-draft coverage airs at 6:30 p.m. ET on ESPN.
"WNBA Orange Carpet Special" pre-draft coverage airs at 5:30 p.m. ET on ESPN2.
Top prospects invited to the 2026 WNBA Draft include Lauren Betts, Azzi Fudd, Awa Fam Thiam, and Olivia Miles.
